content.text:
=== any local keycloak compose/image/service? ===
(empty = no local keycloak)
=== POSTGRES_HOST / job worker env in profile env ===
(absent means defaults apply)

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== any local keycloak compose/image/service? ==="; grep -rniE 'keycloak.*image|image.*keycloak|quay.io/keycloak|bitnami/keycloak|keycloak.*container' --include='*.yaml' --include='*.yml' . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head; echo "(empty = no local keycloak)"; echo "=== POSTGRES_HOST / job worker env in profile env ==="; grep -E '^(POSTGRES_HOST|STUDIO_JOB_WORKER|POSTGRES_PORT)=' /tmp/local-builder.env; echo "(absent means defaults apply)"
